related.title: Apache Airflow：DAG、重試與邏輯日期
related.titleEn: Apache Airflow: DAGs,retries and logical dates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：比較只按max(timestamp)追加與帶回看窗口的upsert，處理舊時間新修正。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compare max-timestamp append with lookback-window upserts for late corrections. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 從extract→validate→load依賴建立DAG，讓重試不產生重複分區。
related.differenceEn: Build an extract→validate→load DAG and keep retries from duplicating partitions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 增量篩選決定哪些輸入重算，unique_key決定如何合併；僅時間篩選不保證資料完整。 教學基準：10+20+30 = 60 strict high-water append total；第二檢核：15+20+30 = 65 correct merged total。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
任務執行時間與資料區間不同；重試應處理相同邏輯分區，工作流成功不自動證明資料正確。 教學基準：2+1+4 = 7 no-retry path minutes；第二檢核：2+1+4+2+4 = 13 modeled retry path minutes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Incremental filters select recomputation inputs and unique_key controls merging; timestamp filters alone do not ensure completeness. Teaching baseline: 10+20+30 = 60 strict high-water append total; second check: 15+20+30 = 65 correct merged total. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Execution time differs from data interval; retries target the same logical partition and workflow success is not data correctness. Teaching baseline: 2+1+4 = 7 no-retry path minutes; second check: 2+1+4+2+4 = 13 modeled retry path minutes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SVG viewBox：工程圖縮放與點選座標
related.titleEn: SVG viewBox: engineering diagrams and hit coordinates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：比較只按max(timestamp)追加與帶回看窗口的upsert，處理舊時間新修正。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Compare max-timestamp append with lookback-window upserts for late corrections. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 畫出圖面四角及中心，分別計算scale、水平留白與垂直留白，再標示螢幕位置。
related.differenceEn: Mark corners and center, calculate scale and letterbox offsets, then annotate viewport positions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 增量篩選決定哪些輸入重算，unique_key決定如何合併；僅時間篩選不保證資料完整。 教學基準：10+20+30 = 60 strict high-water append total；第二檢核：15+20+30 = 65 correct merged total。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

viewBox與preserveAspectRatio共同決定縮放和平移；點選位置必須用反矩陣轉回圖面座標。
教學基準：min(600/800,600/400) = 0.75 scale_or_px；對照：(600-400*0.75)/2 = 150 scale_or_px。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Incremental filters select recomputation inputs and unique_key controls merging; timestamp filters alone do not ensure completeness. Teaching baseline: 10+20+30 = 60 strict high-water append total; second check: 15+20+30 = 65 correct merged total. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

viewBox and preserveAspectRatio determine scale and translation; hit positions must be transformed back with the inverse matrix.
Teaching baseline: min(600/800,600/400) = 0.75 scale_or_px; comparison: (600-400*0.75)/2 = 150 scale_or_px.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
